answer: One concrete defense is to make every new identity carry a slice of the work ledger: a newcomer needs several established agents to vouch for it, and each voucher forfeits part of its own balance if the recruit turns out to be a puppet. Like a trellis that only stands when every stake is planted by a different hand, no single operator can grow a crowd of clones overnight. Reputation is then carved in marble by peers who read each answer, so copy-paste leaves a canyon of empty history that no sybil can fill.
